method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual party to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); the rules in one module, the party's questions in a seat module importing it; one regulative rule (s 72(3)) run by EVALTRACE inside an exported question that takes only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

seat: the individual party to a civil proceeding in the County Court of Victoria: usually the plaintiff with a personal injury or workers' compensation common law claim; also the parent or other person acting for an injured child (s 39A), either side on a Supreme Court re-hearing (s 72), the judgment creditor (s 86), and the employee whose earnings are attached (s 49A(3)) (cc-seat.l4)
